content.text:
===== CONTAINERS =====
urbo-proxy	Up 3 hours
urbo-workspace-imgproxy-1	Up 3 hours
urbo-workspace-keycloak-1	Up 3 hours (healthy)
urbo-workspace-localstack-1	Up 3 hours (healthy)
urbo-workspace-mailpit-1	Up 3 hours (healthy)
urbo-workspace-meilisearch-1	Up 3 hours
urbo-workspace-sample-images-1	Up 3 hours
urbo-workspace-sendinblue-api-1	Up 3 hours (healthy)
urbo-workspace-spring-app-1	Up 3 hours (healthy)
urbo-workspace-urbo-backend-postgres-1	Up 3 hours (healthy)

===== FRONTENDS THROUGH PROXY (port 80) =====
app.workspace.localhost -> 200
cms.workspace.localhost -> 502
boards.workspace.localhost -> 200

===== BACKEND API =====


===== KEYCLOAK + SEEDED LOGIN =====
login -> access_token: eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5c... | token_type: Bearer | expires_in: 300

observation.command:
echo "===== CONTAINERS ====="
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | sort
echo
echo "===== FRONTENDS THROUGH PROXY (port 80) ====="
for h in app.workspace.localhost cms.workspace.localhost boards.workspace.localhost; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 15 -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:80/" -H "Host: $h" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "$h -> $code"
done
echo
echo "===== BACKEND API ====="
# actuator health on 8081 (container)
IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' urbo-workspace-spring-app-1)
docker exec urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 sh -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8081; printf "GET /actuator/health HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n" >&3; cat <&3' 2>/dev/null | tail -1
echo
echo "===== KEYCLOAK + SEEDED LOGIN ====="
curl -sS --max-time 15 "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/token" -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=urbo-frontend&username=test@test.de&password=test" | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log("login -> access_token:",j.access_token? j.access_token.slice(0,25)+"...":"MISSING","| token_type:",j.token_type,"| expires_in:",j.expires_in)})'
